payload.abstract: This dataset provides clinical Named Entity Recognition (NER) and Assertion Classification (AC) annotations for 400 discharge summaries from MIMIC-IV-Note (v2.2), designed to support research on computer-assisted ICD coding and related clinical natural language processing tasks. It comprises 85,328 entity annotations across six categories (Normal Finding, Abnormal Finding, Disorder, Procedure, Health Context, and Medication) and 10,922 assertion labels across five categories (Present, Absent, Possible, Hypothetical, and Not associated with patient). In contrast to prior clinical NER resources, the schema was developed with the ICD-10-CM/PCS coding framework in mind, capturing coding-relevant modifiers such as acuity, laterality, and anatomical site within entity spans. The resource supports entity-centric clinical coding pipelines that use annotated entities as compact downstream inputs, and more broadly enables clinical NER and AC research on MIMIC-IV discharge summaries.
